module: ImGui debug window "Crawl Debug Window" of crawl mode, reserved for developers (disabled by default). Once enabled, it displays for the first active crawler: trail info, vehicle position and speed, status in the zone, penalty points (DNF threshold 50), infraction cooldowns, recovery point, zone exit point (DNF at 10 m), list of nodes with times, log of the last 20 events and trail status. The data comes from gameplay_crawl_utils.getCrawlState.
notes: The window opens on onCrawlStarted only if enableDebugWindow is true.

In drawDebugWindow, im.Begin receives a new im.BoolPtr(debugWindowOpen) every frame: the window's close button therefore does not modify debugWindowOpen (closing is only detected through the return value).
Only the first active crawler found is displayed.

setEnableDebugWindow.desc: Enables or disables the debug window; disabling it closes it and empties the data.

getEnableDebugWindow.desc: Tells whether the debug window is enabled.

onCrawlStarted.desc: Hook called at the start of a crawl: opens the window if debug is enabled.

onCrawlComplete.desc: Hook called at the end of a crawl: marks the data as finished (isFinished).

onCrawlDisqualified.desc: Hook called on disqualification: marks the data as finished and disqualified.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads: resets the window state.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called when the extension unloads: resets the window state.

onPreRender.desc: Hook called before rendering: updates the data from the first active crawler and draws the window.
